summary_en: TX1 Corporation announced a tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of ProjectHoldings, Inc. (9246) at 2,200 yen per share for a 30-business-day period from September 29 to November 11, 2026, with the objective of making the company a wholly owned subsidiary.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of ProjectHoldings, Inc. (Securities Code: 9246) by TX1 Corporation
translation_en_brief:
TX1 Corporation decided on September 28, 2026, to acquire all outstanding shares of ProjectHoldings, Inc., listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market, through a tender offer. The offer price is set at 2,200 yen per share, and the tender offer period runs for 30 business days from September 29 to November 11, 2026. The objective is to make ProjectHoldings a wholly owned subsidiary of TX1 Corporation.

In addition to ordinary shares, TX1 Corporation is also acquiring warrants (new stock acquisition rights) issued under seven separate resolutions dating from November 2018 through July 2026. Each warrant will be purchased at 1 yen per unit. The disclosure does not specify the total number of shares or warrants outstanding, nor does it provide the total consideration amount or the premium relative to any reference price.
